dialogue_storage: PicLex 关键词标签 learning.example/exampleChinese 保存 canonical A,B,A,B 4 话轮对白（A=学习者朗读评分，B=机器朗读不评分，角色标记不朗读）；角色说明仅保留在 cards.roles 元数据；cards.targets 各词 example_en/example_zh 仍为定稿摘录。
communication_goal: 清楚说明权限缺失，并确认获得访问权限的下一步。
image_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE standalone finished educational scene illustration, square 1024x1024. Pure white background, clean consistent black line art, minimalist adult stick figures with circular heads, simple expressive faces and thin limbs, restrained polished programmer workplace comic aesthetic. No color, no gradients, no shading, no photographic rendering. One coherent scene, no panels. Keep all people and props in the central area approximately x=180..820 and y=220..790 on a 0..1000 canvas. Preserve generous empty white space at top (y<180), bottom (y>850), and sides for learning labels added later. Make the named learning props clearly recognizable and fully visible. Gestures should show a conversation. No speech balloons, letters, numbers, captions, logos, watermarks, readable code, or long text; simple abstract UI marks are allowed. Scene: Two adult stick-figure coworkers at a desk. The seated developer on the left holds an open palm asking for help beside a fully visible open laptop in the center. The teammate on the right leans forward and points at the laptop screen to explain how to accept an invitation. On the screen only a simple envelope icon inside a rounded rectangle, no text, no letters, no code. Keep the entire laptop screen and keyboard visible. Friendly onboarding support.

coverage_review.scope: W003 的逐词编辑与底图视觉核对完成；本专题其他计划卡未制作，不声称学习效果或手机端验收。

inversion.note: 原图保留；本卡发布用图为原图精确 RGB 反色（黑底白线）。

annotation_coordinate_system: [x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max]，左上角为原点，按最终 images/W003.png 宽高归一化至 0..1；由人工视觉定位。

image_review.summary: 通过：开发者向同事求助，桌上完整打开的笔记本可见，屏幕只有信封图标。权限、邀请、仓库与推送状态由对白设定，不把图标当真实权限证据；无角色说明或文字进入底图。
